spots.text: Everything in this orchard was planted by somebody who wanted to sit exactly here.

meta.label: The Orchard
meta.blurb: The trees are heavy this year. Pick whatever you like; it is all the same fruit, more or less, and none of it is quite ripe.

secrets.name: The Platform in the Tree
secrets.text: Nobody looks at the back of the big tree. Up here someone has put a chair, a lamp and a stack of the ones that fell, and the glass is close enough to touch.
